items.title: Supermicro Stock In Focus After AI Revenue Outlook Lift
items.summary: Super Micro Computer raised its fiscal 2027 revenue outlook, expects AI related solutions to account for roughly 70% to 80% of sales, and is rolling out new AMD EPYC based all flash storage and H15 servers to support AI data center buildouts. The business plans to lift production capacity to more than 8,000 racks per month by December 2026, including over 4,000 direct liquid cooled racks, which points to a heavy operational commitment to large scale AI infrastructure deployments.
